scope: Re-analysis of one native EMPF fold/seed (fold 0, seed 0): 25 GAN TRAIN donors and 12 held-out development donors already used in development selection. No new generation or training. Bootstrap CIs resample these 12 donors only; they do not include fold/seed or training variability.

baseline.compared: raw_heldout, calibrated_heldout, raw_train x mean/sd/combined x coverage/below/above/width/interval_score

readouts.loo: v2 leave-one-donor-out symmetric SD calibration over 12 held-out donors (n=11, rank 10, nominal 10/12)
readouts.loo_asym: v2 leave-one-donor-out separate lower/upper SD corrections at alpha/2 each (n=11, rank 11 = max, union-bound nominal 10/12)
